5-year anniversary of UCC-1 filings (June 2029)

UCC-1 financing statements filed with the Delaware Secretary of State and the Loudoun County Circuit Court are effective for a period of five (5) years from the date of filing. Continuation statements (UCC-3) must be filed within six (6) months prior to the expiration of the initial filing period (i.e., between December 2028 and June 2029) to maintain the perfection of the Collateral Agent's security interest.
